name: Mezametara Shiranai Otoko ga Makuramoto ni Ita
original_name: 目覚めたら知らない男が枕元にいた
source:
Misumi Iroha is an ordinary office worker. However, she is active as a VTuber, keeping her activities secret from her friends and family. 
One night, she awoke to see an unknown man smoking by her bedside.
Just who is this man, and what is he planning?
Whilst being toyed with by the man's maddened words and actions, Iroha waits for an opportunity to make her escape.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/30148]Freem![/url]]
translation:
三隅伊吕波是一位普通的上班族。然而，她作为VTuber很活跃，对朋友和家人保密她的活动。
一天晚上，她醒来发现一名陌生男子在她床边抽烟。
这个男人到底是谁，他到底有何打算？
彩羽一边被男人的疯狂言行所玩弄，一边等待着逃跑的机会。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/30148]Freem![/url]]
